display.purpose: Screen titles and verse references. Besley, the tune-name voice.

scripture.purpose: The verse itself, measured to 34ch in the cover.

title.purpose: Verse references inside lists and sheets.

label.purpose: Topic names, group titles, legend. 11px uppercase.

shadows.name: sheet-lift
shadows.purpose: Bottom sheets only; the single shadow in the system.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: All entrances: screen-in 320ms, sheet rise 400ms, recite cover 380ms.

motion.name: caret-blink
motion.purpose: The insertion caret in the recitation cover.

motion.name: miss-shake
motion.purpose: 3px horizontal shake when a wrong letter is typed.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one bright object on a screen: Begin, or the suggested grade.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary">Begin <svg width="19" height="19" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 12h15M13 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; height: 52px; min-width: 200px; padding: 0 22px; border: 0; border-radius: 14px; background: var(--bone, #EDE7DA); color: var(--ink, #0A0E1A); font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #FFFAF0; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.985); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E5B665; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #141B2E; color: #767D90; cursor: default; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action that must not compete with the bright object.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { height: 48px; padding: 0 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(237,231,218,0.2); border-radius: 12px; background: transparent; color: var(--bone, #EDE7DA); font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: rgba(237,231,218,0.32); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E5B665; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Verse Row
components.description: A ruled line in the library or due list: shape, reference, first words, due state.
components.css: .ds-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 14px minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; min-height: 58px; padding: 12px 0; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(237,231,218,0.1); background: transparent; color: var(--bone, #EDE7DA); text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-row:hover { background: #0E1424; } .ds-row-mark { display: flex; justify-content: center; } .ds-row-main { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px; min-width: 0; } .ds-row-ref { font-family: 'Literata Variable', Georgia, serif; font-size: 15.5px; font-weight: 600; color: #EDE7DA; } .ds-row-preview { font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; color: #A6ACBB; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-row-due { font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; color: #A6ACBB; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: State Chip
components.description: Shape plus word, so the stage is never conveyed by color alone.
components.html: Holding
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 4px 9px 4px 7px; border: 1px solid currentColor; border-radius: 999px; color: #8FC3AC; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.01em; }

components.css: .ds-begin { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; padding: 22px; border: 1px solid rgba(237,231,218,0.1); border-radius: 18px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #0E1424, #0A0E1A); } .ds-begin-line { font-family: 'Besley Variable', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.45rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.02em; color: #EDE7DA; margin: 0; } .ds-num { color: #E5B665; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-begin-meta { margin: 6px 0 0; font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #A6ACBB; } .ds-sample { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; padding-top: 16px; border-top: 1px solid rgba(237,231,218,0.1); } .ds-sample-head { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-sample-ref { font-family: 'Besley Variable', Georgia, serif; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; color: #EDE7DA; } .ds-tag { font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.09em; color: #A6ACBB; border: 1px solid rgba(237,231,218,0.2); border-radius: 5px; padding: 3px 6px 2px; } .ds-sample-note { font-family: 'Hanken Grotesk Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px; color: #767D90; } .ds-verse { font-family: 'Literata Variable', Georgia, serif; font-size: 16.5px; line-height: 1.75; color: #EDE7DA; margin: 0; max-width: 34ch; } .ds-blank { display: inline-block; border-bottom: 1.5px solid rgba(229,182,101,0.45); padding-bottom: 1px; }

components.name: Shape Sheet
components.description: The only progress visual: five ruled rows of twelve solfege marks.
components.css: .ds-sheet-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 26px minmax(0,1fr) auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; width: 100%; padding: 13px 0 14px; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(237,231,218,0.1); background: transparent; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-sheet-row:hover { background: #0E1424; } .ds-sheet-letter { font-family: 'Besley Variable', Georgia, serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; color: #E5B665; } .ds-sheet-name { font-family: 'Literata Variable', Georgia, serif; font-size: 14.5px; font-weight: 500; color: #EDE7DA; } .ds-sheet-marks { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 4px; max-width: 240px; }

narrative.overview: The app is a hymnal read under one lamp. Its ground is the ink of a night-edition binding, its text is bone, and its only bright substance is brass: the metal of the caret, the blank, the mark that fills in. Where a hymnbook sets syllables under shaped notes, this app sets verses under blanks, and the four shapes that carry the notation carry the product's state as well.
keyCharacteristics: One ink ground, one bone text, one brass accent, two state colors borrowed from the notation.
Ruled blanks instead of input boxes; the missing text is a 1px brass line.
Four geometric shapes as the entire state alphabet; no icon substitutes.
Display type for references and section names only; the working UI stays in the grotesk.
Motion is a single rise and a single caret blink.

rules.name: The One Bright Object Rule
rules.body: Exactly one bone-filled control appears per screen: Begin on Today, the recommended grade in recitation.

rules.name: The Metal Rule
rules.body: Brass marks what is incomplete, due, or suggested. It never fills a card and never appears as a gradient.

rules.name: The Tune-Name Rule
rules.body: Display type belongs to the thing being memorized and the section that holds it. A button, tab, or settings row never sets in Besley.

rules.name: The Measure Rule
rules.body: Scripture never exceeds 34ch in the recitation cover and 40ch in a sheet.

rules.name: The Border-Or-Shadow Rule
rules.body: A surface gets a hairline or the sheet lift, never both.

dos: Do keep every missing letter a 1px brass rule at 22% opacity, set on the baseline.
Do pair a shape with its word in any chip or legend.
Do let one element per screen be filled.
Do keep the verse measure at 34ch in the cover and 40ch in a sheet.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion by collapsing the sheet rise and caret blink.
donts: Don't introduce a fifth state glyph, a progress ring, a streak flame, or a percentage badge.
Don't put display type in buttons, tabs, chips, or settings rows.
Don't add a second accent hue for success or brand.
Don't box a list row in a card, and don't nest a card in a card.
Don't use gradient text, glass, sparkles, or emoji.
